description: Search and book hotel rooms available for a few hours during the day, not overnight. Search worldwide Dayuse inventory by city, budget, amenities, and time; view results on an interactive map; inspect hotel details; compare hotels; get answers to booking questions; and continue to dayuse.com to complete a reservation.
